operator_has_creator_allowance.meaning: operator holds creator allowance enabling campaign creation
operator_has_creator_allowance.evidence: `_createCampaign` never enforces that `startTimestamp` (or end time) is in the future. An operator with creator allowance can create a campaign that already ended; the contract still pulls tokens from the creator into Distributor, but no Merkle root will ever be produced for the finished campaign, leaving funds idle and unrecoverable by the creator.

preconditions.text: An operator holds creator allowance enabling campaign creation.; The submitted startTimestamp (or end time) is not in the future, so the campaign is already ended.; The creator has predeposited reward tokens available to be pulled.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

An operator with creator allowance can create a campaign that already ended; the contract still pulls tokens from the creator into Distributor, but no Merkle root will ever be produced for the finished campaign, leaving funds idle and unrecoverable by the creator.

safety.text: Campaign creation should reject a startTimestamp that is not in the future (and an end time not after block.timestamp), so funds are not pulled for an already-ended campaign.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.
evidence: `_createCampaign` never enforces that `startTimestamp` (or end time) is in the future. An operator with creator allowance can create a campaign that already ended; the contract still pulls tokens from the creator into Distributor, but no Merkle root will ever be produced for the finished campaign, leaving funds idle and unrecoverable by the creator.

- `_createCampaign` checks only `duration >= HOUR` and whitelist/min amounts; it omits `startTimestamp >= block.timestamp` and `startTimestamp + duration > block.timestamp` (DistributionCreator.sol:526-543).

effects.text: The creator's predeposited rewards remain idle in Distributor and are unrecoverable by the creator.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The operator's allowance is sufficient to create a campaign on behalf of the creator.
The creator's predeposited rewards are available in the creator account before _createCampaign executes.
The backdated startTimestamp is the only malformed time input considered in this core claim.

limitations: Only the funds-locked impact is formalized; i_no_merkle_root, i_fees_charged and i_full_amount_loss are deferred to future claims.
The condition uses grounded Boolean observables because the report states the qualitative time condition without numeric timestamp values.
The relation encodes rejection of the backdated creation and absence of the token pull as the desired outcome; the actual revert/return mechanism is left to code binding.
The operator authorization scope is represented only by the report-stated creator allowance, not by a concrete role or permissionless check.
